description: Eight synthetic messy tickets; two per policy code. Expected labels and rationales are scoring-only and must never be sent to the model.

input.intake: Customer says the dashboard is slow and blames a routine queue. A forwarded chat mentions a token problem but has no signed evidence.

events.detail: sealed payload digest differs from accepted digest

cases.rationale: Current attested CaseLedger seal mismatch overrides the noisy intake.

input.intake: A draft says this is probably only an author-name correction. The requester is shouting that access is broken.

cases.rationale: Multiple current findings; evidence containment B outranks D and A.

input.intake: A bot claims file corruption. The customer calls it a press issue; neither statement is verified.

cases.rationale: Unverified seal claim is ineligible; current access finding outranks publication.

input.intake: A prior incident card says the seal broke, but that card was superseded. The present ticket includes a current access audit.

cases.rationale: Old seal finding is superseded; current seal match is not a trigger; current revoked grant selects D.

input.intake: An email demands immediate access repair, but the email has no signed grant record. The page shows two different curator contacts.

events.detail: public contact differs from accepted metadata

cases.rationale: Only current authoritative publication conflict qualifies.

input.intake: Customer speculates that the hash is wrong. An old access ticket is pasted into a publication review request.

events.detail: accepted metadata lists a different public author

cases.rationale: Current publication finding remains after unverified seal and superseded access are excluded.

input.intake: Three callers independently say there is a seal mismatch and a revoked grant; one also claims wrong public authorship. No signed case record confirms any of this.

cases.rationale: No current attested CaseLedger triggering event; repeat rumors do not promote authority.

input.intake: The old digest alert is still in a pasted transcript. The signed current check says the seal matches. A bot says access was revoked.

cases.rationale: Current seal match and superseded/unverified other claims trigger no category.
